name: piZap
description_en:
piZap is a browser and app photo editor for expressive edits, collages and simple designs, with filters, text, stickers and touch-up tools.

Pro adds assets and higher-resolution saves, while newer AI features have separate quota and rights considerations.
description_zh:
piZap 是网页及 App 照片编辑器，面向趣味编辑、拼贴和简单设计，提供滤镜、文字、贴纸及修饰工具。

Pro 增加素材和更高分辨率保存；较新的 AI 功能还需单独核对额度与权利。

core_features.explanation_en: The editor page documents crop/rotate, brightness, contrast, saturation, tint, text, stickers, doodles, borders and frames.
core_features.explanation_zh: 编辑器页列出裁切、旋转、亮度、对比度、饱和度、色调、文字、贴纸、涂鸦、边框和相框。

core_features.name_en: Pro asset access and HD/4K saves
core_features.name_zh: Pro 素材与高清/4K 保存
core_features.explanation_en: The Pro details page lists additional assets, advanced touch-ups, ad-free fullscreen editing and ultra-HD/4K saved images.
core_features.explanation_zh: Pro 详情页列出额外素材、高级修饰、无广告全屏编辑及超高清/4K 成品保存。

core_features.name_zh: AI 提供方与额度单独核对
core_features.explanation_en: Current terms cover prompts/images/masks sent through AI features and distinguish paid Pro and AI Pro without publishing an unlimited AI entitlement.
core_features.explanation_zh: 现行条款涵盖 AI 功能处理的提示词、图像和蒙版，并区分 Pro 与 AI Pro，但未建立无限 AI 权益。

sections.title_en: A quick decorated image or collage
sections.title_zh: 快速制作装饰照片或拼贴
sections.en:
piZap’s documented emphasis is approachable photo decoration and layout. Crop or rotate a source, adjust brightness/contrast/saturation/tint, then add a filter, text, stickers, a frame or doodles. The product also links collage, meme and simple card/design modes. For a birthday invitation, an editorial workflow is to choose the final layout first, fit photographs, add readable text and inspect the saved image at delivery size.

This is a capability-based sequence rather than an account-tested click tutorial. The material does not establish professional RAW processing, calibrated color management, editable layered interchange or print-production controls. Pro’s larger saved image can help a design fit a channel, but more pixels do not guarantee that a low-resolution source or downloaded sticker will print cleanly.
sections.zh:
piZap 文档的重点是易上手的照片装饰与排版。可先裁切或旋转原图、调整亮度/对比度/饱和度/色调，再加入滤镜、文字、贴纸、边框或涂鸦。产品还链接拼贴、表情包和简单卡片/设计模式。以生日邀请为例，编辑建议是先确定最终布局，再放入照片、添加易读文字，并按交付尺寸检查保存成品。

这是按已记录能力组织的流程，并非账户实测的逐按钮教程。材料未建立专业 RAW 处理、校准色彩管理、分层可编辑格式交换或印前控制能力。Pro 较大的成品尺寸有助于适配渠道，但更多像素不保证低分辨率原图或下载贴纸能清晰印刷。

sections.title_en: Pro pricing and the trial clock
sections.en:
The Pro details page quoted USD 9.99 billed monthly or USD 59.99 billed yearly, presenting the annual plan as USD 4.99 per month equivalent. It offers a seven-day Pro trial and says canceling within the first seven days avoids billing. The annual total is the explicit billed amount; the displayed equivalent is rounded and should not be multiplied into a different yearly charge.

Pro lists ad-free fullscreen editing, additional fonts/filters/borders/templates/stock, advanced touch-ups, priority support and ultra-HD/4K saves. The page’s broad “unlock everything” description does not establish unlimited current AI generation: the newer terms separately name Pro and AI Pro and permit metered credits, quotas and throttling. Exact AI Pro pricing, available models and per-operation consumption remain unknown here.
sections.zh:
Pro 详情页报价为每月实付 USD9.99，或每年实付 USD59.99，并将年付展示为折合每月 USD4.99。页面提供七天 Pro 试用，并称在前七天内取消可避免收费。年付总额应采用明确实扣数，展示折算值经过取整，不能乘出另一年费。

Pro 列出无广告全屏编辑、额外字体/滤镜/边框/模板/图库、高级修饰、优先支持和超高清/4K 保存。页面笼统的“解锁全部”不证明当前 AI 生成无限：较新条款另行提及 Pro 和 AI Pro，并允许按点数、配额和限流计量。AI Pro 的具体价格、可用模型和单次消耗在此仍未知。

sections.title_en: Asset search does not clear asset rights
sections.title_zh: 素材搜索不等于完成授权
sections.en:
The Pro page includes web image and sticker search, but search availability does not give permission to use every result commercially. The current terms reserve the platform and its assets, give a limited personal/internal-business service license and require users to have rights to uploaded, edited, generated and shared content. Third-party font and asset licenses can impose additional conditions.

For a small business card or promotion, use owned photographs or verify the actual image, sticker and font license. Do not assume a paid Pro plan supplies a trademark license or that an asset is exclusive. The user retains rights in their content subject to others’ rights and grants an operational/improvement license; the terms say marketing use of privately saved content needs permission. That is narrower than assuming private content is never processed by the service.
sections.zh:
Pro 页包含网页图片和贴纸搜索，但可搜索不代表每个结果都获准商用。现行条款保留平台及素材权利，授予有限的个人/内部业务服务许可，并要求用户对上传、编辑、生成和分享内容拥有必要权利。第三方字体和素材许可还可能增加条件。

制作小企业名片或促销图时，应使用自有照片，或核对实际图片、贴纸和字体许可。不能认为付费 Pro 会提供商标许可，也不能认为素材具有排他性。用户在不侵犯他人权利的前提下保留内容权利，并授予服务运营/改进许可；条款说将私密保存内容用于营销需要许可。这比“私密内容从不被服务处理”的假设更有限。

sections.title_en: Treat AI and saved projects as separate dependencies
sections.title_zh: 分别评估 AI 与保存项目
sections.en:
The current terms explain that AI features can process prompts, photographs, masks and settings through piZap or third-party providers. Outputs may be inaccurate, nonunique or unsuitable and are not guaranteed protectable, lawful or non-infringing. Check faces, wording and borrowed styles before using an AI result; this research did not execute any generation.

The editor page advertises free unlimited storage for edited photographs. That statement alone does not establish a permanent archive, backup recovery, retention after account closure or uninterrupted future access. Save originals and final images elsewhere. The full provider-specific AI retention and training chain, output format controls and account-storage behavior were not established, so this record does not promise local-only editing or zero third-party transmission.
sections.zh:
现行条款解释，AI 功能可能通过 piZap 或第三方提供方处理提示词、照片、蒙版和设置。输出可能不准确、不独特或不适用，也不保证可受保护、合法或不侵权。使用 AI 成品前应检查人脸、文字和借用风格；本研究未执行生成。

编辑器页宣传对已编辑照片提供免费无限存储。单凭这句话无法建立永久档案、备份恢复、关闭账户后保留或未来持续访问的保证。原片和成品应另行保存。各 AI 提供方的完整保留和训练链、输出格式控制及账户存储行为尚未建立，因此本记录不承诺仅本地编辑或零第三方传输。

sections.title_en: Cancellation depends on where the plan was purchased
sections.en:
Paid plans may renew automatically until canceled. The current terms direct web users to the account page, billing provider or support, while app-store subscriptions normally use the relevant store’s account tools. They describe reasonable efforts to refund a paid web subscription canceled and requested within seven days after a charge, subject to abuse, chargeback, store and legal conditions; this is not an unconditional guarantee. Otherwise cancellation usually stops renewal and access continues to the end of the paid period.

piZap is a documentation-based candidate for expressive social images and simple collages when its available assets and saved output meet the task. Exact free export limits, AI Pro economics, team controls, accessibility and business-grade support response were not verified. No subscription, cancellation, saved-project recovery or delivered print was tested.
sections.zh:
付费套餐可能持续自动续费，直到取消。现行条款指引网页用户通过账户页、支付服务方或客服处理，应用商店订阅通常通过对应商店账户工具处理。网页付费订阅在扣款后七天内取消并申请退款时，条款描述会合理努力退款，但受滥用、拒付、商店和法律条件影响，并非无条件保证。其他情况下，取消通常停止续费，访问持续到已付周期结束。

如果素材及保存输出符合任务，文档显示 piZap 可作为趣味社交图和简单拼贴的候选。免费导出具体限制、AI Pro 成本、团队控制、可访问性和企业级支持响应尚未核实。没有实测订阅、取消、保存项目恢复或印刷交付。
